probe:impostor.summary:
P9 tested whether P_R5 is an impostor pose of the nearly symmetric I58 brainstem body, i.e. whether a symmetric partner of P_R5 aligns BOTH the body and the cerebellar folia. Result: no such partner exists. At P_R5 the MRI cerebellum block lands 12.4 mm from the OCT's folded pieces (8 mm shallower along OCT depth, 7 mm in y, 6 mm in x; folia Dice 0.003) while the body fits (body Dice 0.60, qc_fine rim median 2.02 mm). The six principal-axis partners (3 x R180, 3 reflections about the mask centroid) never bring the folia together (Dice <= 0.086 at start, <= 0.085 after refinement; folia-centroid distance >= 9.2 mm). The three folia-targeted partners I added (S9 minimal rotation 71.5 deg, S10 R180 about the folia/pieces bisector, S11 reflection) do put the cerebellum on the pieces (centroid 1.8-3.0 mm) but only by breaking the body: body Dice 0.43-0.49, rim 2.2-2.9 mm, sign-corrected NCC ~0.01 with mixed polarity, MI32 0.026-0.046 (P_R5 0.084); union refinement from them drifts back toward the body and away from the folia (3.2-8.3 mm). Body-only and folia-only optima disagree at EVERY start (4.2-16.4 mm at the block corners; 7.6 mm / 15.8 deg at P_R5) - the 'disagreement everywhere' signature. The OCT folia cue is a 3-D scatter of fragments spanning 4-25 mm of depth (97 components after 0.3 mm erosion) whereas the MRI cerebellum is one compact 2-mm-thick laminated slab, geometry no rigid/affine pose can reconcile.

WHAT THE FIGURES SHOW (qc_fine.png, planes z=39/68/96/125/154 = 5.8/10.2/14.4/18.8/23.1 mm):
P_R5 (qc_S0_start = the run's own qc_fine.png, and qc_S0_union which moved only 3 mm): 5.8 and 10.2 mm - the MRI body outline (cyan) follows the OCT body outline on the top and right within ~1-2 mm and the diagonal fibre-bundle texture of the MRI body lies over the OCT's bundle region with similar orientation (bundle-like Canny arcs, no one-to-one match visible); the bright laminated MRI cerebellum sits at the lower-left over smooth OCT tissue / the OCT's shallow streaky band - it does NOT align with any OCT folia. 14.4 mm - body outline still fits; a small bright MRI piece at the bottom-left lies near, but not on, the OCT's small bottom pieces. 18.8 mm - the MRI via T covers only the left part of the OCT body with a straight edge (the MRI FOV face); the OCT's large folded pieces at the lower-left lie under a thin MRI sliver / smooth MRI body. 23.1 mm - almost no MRI tissue (outside the MRI FOV) where the OCT has its largest folded pieces: the deep-end pieces have no MRI counterpart at all at this pose.
S1-union = T_best (best folia Dice 0.114, P_v1 refined, moved 10.1 mm / 27 deg, det 0.867): 5.8-10.2 mm - body outline follows the OCT top outline; the MRI cerebellum at the bottom-left overlaps the OCT's SHALLOW textured band (overlap median depth 5.7 mm) - this is where all of its Dice comes from; 14.4 mm - body covered, small MRI piece near the OCT small pieces; 18.8 mm - the OCT folded pieces lie under smooth MRI body; 23.1 mm - no MRI tissue over the OCT pieces. So T_best does not align the deep-end pieces either.
S10-start (the flip that swings the cerebellum onto the pieces, folia centroid 1.8 mm): at 5.8-14.4 mm the MRI tissue via T covers only an oblique lower-left wedge of the OCT block (body outline broken, the OCT body's upper half has no MRI over it); at 18.8-23.1 mm the MRI cerebellum overlays the OCT folded pieces (checkerboard shows white MRI folia interleaved with the OCT laminae) while the smooth MRI body covers the rest of the pieces. qc_S9_folia (folia-only optimum, centroid 1.2 mm): same picture - cerebellum on the pieces at 18.8-23.1 mm, but a straight MRI-FOV face cuts through the OCT body in every plane (rim 2.76 mm, NCC ~0, MI 0.027).
S7-union (mirrored, det -1; best body Dice 0.657, rim 1.86/1.52, NCC 0.173): the MRI cerebellum lands on the OCT pieces at 23.1 mm, but at 5.8-10.2 mm the MRI FOV face cuts straight across the OCT body and the right part of the body is uncovered; a mirror image cannot be physical unless the OCT handedness were wrong.
probe:impostor.recipe:
Code: work/probe_xr/impostor/p9_impostor.py (subcommands cues, starts, starts2, run, restarts_eval, collect, qc; CPU, 4 threads; imports octreg.fine Level/FineRefiner/MI32/polarity_guard/erode_ball/pose_move, octreg.common resample_to_grid/pool_mean_np, octreg.refine params_from_matrix; calls octreg/scripts/qc_fine.py for figures).
1. Cues. MRI pooled to 0.16 mm (pool_mean_np x2, tissue cleaned: closing 1 vox + fill + cc >= 1 mm3, 13.33 cm3). MRI folia = tissue eroded 0.4 mm & 0.6-mm local mean > p80 (1.143) & 0.6-mm local std > p80 (0.0863); closing 0.6 mm + fill + opening 0.3 mm + components >= 0.1 cm3 -> 0.65 cm3 in 2 components (0.54 cerebellum block at the top of the MRI FOV + 0.11 small folded piece). MRI body = tissue minus the laminated block (folia closed 0.5 mm, dilated 0.3 mm) = 12.1 cm3. OCT folia (0.15 mm): bright tissue (I > 0.5 x mask median = 8519, mask eroded 1.0 mm, valid eroded 3 vox) & 0.6-mm local std > p85 (2964) & 0.6-mm local mean > p30, EXCLUDING the zone within 1.2 mm of the smooth-body core (low-std tissue opened 1.0 mm, cc >= 1 cm3, 6.5 cm3) - this removes the bright specimen surface layer that a plain std cue picks up (three iterations of looking at the PNGs: the first cue was mostly rim, a 'no dark voxels within 1 mm' rule killed the sulci of the pieces, a high-std-density rule killed everything but a shallow patch); same closing/opening/cc -> 0.67 cm3 = the folded laminar pieces at the deep end (56 % deeper than 15 mm) plus a rounded textured piece and a striped patch at the shallow z- face (25 % shallower than 7 mm). OCT body = mask minus the closed/dilated folia = 16.6 cm3.
2. Starts. PCA of the OCT mask voxels in OCT world (centroid c = c_o + [-0.5,-0.4,-0.9] mm zyx; axes sd 9.8/7.9/6.2 mm). S0 = P_R5, S1 = P_v1, S2-4 = P_R5 @ R180(pc_k about c), S5-7 = P_R5 @ reflect(plane normal pc_k through c). S8 skipped: the mirrored wm_bright=False polarity trial (work/runs/v11/I58bs_s40, NCC 0.097, centre [1.7,2.8,19.7]; I58_seed1 [1.5,2.8,19.6]) stores only its centre, and the current xiangrui_I58bs run's False trial is non-mirrored ([0.2,-1.5,21.3]); its centre is 9.9 mm from P_R5's so it is not a centroid-symmetric partner. Added S9 = P_R5 @ minimal rotation (71.5 deg about zyx [-0.74,0.33,0.59]) taking the OCT-pieces centroid onto the MRI-folia centroid (so inv(S9) maps the cerebellum onto the pieces), S10 = P_R5 @ R180 about the bisector, S11 = P_R5 @ reflection about the plane with normal (u_folia - u_pieces).
3. Metrics at a pose (no optimisation): folia/body Dice (MRI cue via inv T onto the OCT 0.15 grid), folia-centroid distance (MRI folia mapped into OCT world vs OCT folia), sign-corrected flattened NCC of the fine machinery at 0.3 and 0.15 mm on the union mask L.spec_mask(T) (FineRefiner with sign -1 = the I58 relation; guard sign and frac_neg reported), MI32 (edges fixed at T), NCC on the body / folia masks at 0.3 mm, and a qc_fine-Q1 re-implementation (forward: OCT mask boundary voxels >= 3 vox from faces & >= 2 from black tiles, normals from the smoothed mask, distance to the cleaned MRI tissue boundary via a 0.16-mm EDT; rim faces = all but z+; validated at P_R5: 1.993 / deep 2.162 vs qc_fine 2.018 / 2.179 mm).
4. Refinement: FineRefiner (delta about the start, T = T0 @ D) on two Levels (0.3 then 0.15 mm, whole-MRI box, flatten 3 mm, erode 1.3 mm), steps rigid 150 -> similarity 100 -> affine 200 at 0.3 mm (lr_rot 0.01, lr_t 0.15, lr_ls/sh 0.005) and rigid 50 -> similarity 50 -> affine 150 at 0.15 mm (lrs halved), clamp 0.15 relative, reg 0.5, sign = guard sign at the start (fallback -1). Union: mask = spec_mask(T) rebuilt per level; 3 restarts with a random 3 mm translation + 5 deg rotation about c_o through the same chain; cluster = pairwise block-corner distances. Body-only: mask = MRI body eroded 1.3 mm via T & OCT mask & valid. Folia-only: mask = (MRI folia dilated 0.3 mm via T | OCT folia) & OCT mask & valid, sign = guard on the folia mask if nonzero. Agreement = block-corner mean distance between the body-only and folia-only results (and each vs the union). 11 starts in 5 detached processes (~8 min per start); restarts_eval computed the metrics at all 33 restart solutions; collect wrote summary.md/json and T_best.npy (best folia Dice after union refinement).
5. qc_fine.py (--skip-landscape) in temp run dirs (T_oct2mri = pose, T_oct2mri_structural = P_R5, T_oct2mri_prefine = the start, result.json copied) for S0 start (= P_R5), S0 union, S1 union (T_best), S7 union, S10 start, S10 union, S9 folia; PNGs downloaded and inspected.

probe:impostor.caveats: 1) The cues are heuristic. The OCT folia cue contains, besides the unambiguous folded pieces at the deep end (56 % of it deeper than 15 mm), a rounded textured piece and a striped patch at the shallow z- face (25 % shallower than 7 mm) that may be surface texture rather than folia; T_best's folia Dice of 0.114 comes entirely from the MRI cerebellum overlapping that shallow patch (overlap depth 4-10 mm), not from the deep pieces, so 'best by folia Dice' is not a meaningful winner. 2) The folia Dice ceiling is ~0.1-0.15 even when the cue centroids coincide (S10 start: 1.8 mm, Dice 0.104) because the MRI cue is one 2-mm-thick laminated slab and the OCT cue a 3-D scatter of fragments; the folia-centroid distance is the more informative number. 3) The refinement chain (rigid -> similarity -> affine per level) caps only log-scale/shear (0.15 relative per step, accumulating over steps and levels: T_best det 0.867) and not rotation/translation, so starts with negative NCC drifted 8-18 mm / 17-50 deg; those 'union' poses are not local refinements of the symmetric partners. 4) NCC/MI on the union mask depend on the mask volume (3.4-7.1 cm3 across poses); the high NCC of the mirrored S5/S6 (0.17) sits on 3.4-3.9 cm3 masks vs 4.7 cm3 at P_R5 and is not comparable. 5) Chain sign = guard sign at the start when defined, else -1; the folia-mask guard was 0 (mixed) at most starts, so folia chains mostly ran with sign -1. 6) The rim numbers in the tables are my 0.16-mm re-implementation of qc_fine Q1 forward (validated at P_R5: 1.993/2.162 vs qc_fine 2.018/2.179 mm); qc_fine.py itself was run for 7 poses (numbers quoted). 7) Only 3 restarts per start with fixed 3 mm / 5 deg perturbations (the pipeline uses 8 with U(2,6) deg / +-2 mm), single seed, CPU. 8) S8 was not reconstructible (rotation not stored); the first S9 run had the rotation direction inverted (kept as run_S9_wrongdir.json), the corrected S9 is the one reported. 9) The MRI is cropped to 27x39x40 mm and the OCT block is 29x40x32 mm: at P_R5 the OCT deep-end pieces (z > 19 mm) map outside/at the edge of the MRI FOV (no MRI tissue at the 23.1 mm plane), and poses that bring the cerebellum onto the pieces push the body across an MRI FOV face (straight cyan edges in qc_S9_folia / qc_S10_start); part of the body-vs-folia conflict may therefore be an FOV/crop issue rather than tissue motion alone. 10) The 'pieces moved' reading rests on the assumption that the MRI cerebellum block and the OCT folded pieces are the same tissue; P7 tests that directly. All outputs went only into work/probe_xr/impostor/ and /tmp; no pipeline files were modified.
probe:impostor.verdict: PIECES MOVED (not impostor); the impostor hypothesis is rejected for every symmetric partner tested. Evidence: (1) at P_R5 the body fits (body Dice 0.60, qc_fine rim 2.02 mm, guard sign -1 with 76 % negative tiles) while the MRI cerebellum lands 12.4 mm from the OCT folded pieces (folia Dice 0.003; 8 mm shallower along OCT depth, 7 mm y, 6 mm x) and the deep-end pieces fall outside the MRI FOV; (2) none of the six principal-axis partners (3 x R180, 3 reflections) aligns the folia before (Dice <= 0.086, centroid >= 9.2 mm) or after refinement (Dice <= 0.085), and their body fits are no better than P_R5's; (3) the three partners built specifically to swing the cerebellum onto the pieces (S9/S10/S11: centroid 1.2-3.0 mm) break the body (body Dice 0.41-0.49, rim 2.2-2.9 mm, NCC ~0.01 with mixed polarity, MI32 0.026-0.046 vs 0.084 at P_R5) and the union objective pulls them back toward the body and away from the folia (3.2-8.3 mm); (4) the body-only and folia-only optima disagree at every one of the 11 starts (4.2-16.4 mm at the block corners; 7.6 mm / 15.8 deg at P_R5) - the 'disagreement everywhere' signature the task defined for pieces-moved, with no start showing the 'agreement at one start' impostor signature; (5) the OCT folia cue is 97 fragments spread over 4-25 mm of depth whereas the MRI cerebellum is one compact laminated slab, a geometry no rigid/affine pose can reconcile. Residual uncertainty: the union objective around P_R5 is a broad multi-optimum plateau (restarts 7 mm away with equal NCC/MI), so P_R5 itself is only body-level accurate; and part of the conflict may be the MRI crop (the OCT deep end has no MRI counterpart at P_R5) rather than tissue motion alone.
